figures.label: Jio Platforms IPO issue size crore
figures.evidence: The Rs 30,213 crore IPO offered shares at a price band of Rs 1,065–1,119 apiece.

figures.label: Jio Platforms fresh issue shares crore
figures.evidence: The IPO comprised 27 crore fresh equity shares, with no offer-for-sale (OFS) component. The company plans to utilise up to Rs 27,500 crore from the net proceeds to repay or prepay borrowings of its subsidiary, Reliance Jio Infocomm.

figures.label: Jio Platforms retail minimum lot shares
figures.evidence: Retail investors were required to bid for a minimum of 12 shares, an investment of Rs 13,428 at the upper end of the price band.

figures.label: Jio Platforms retail minimum application amount
figures.evidence: Retail investors were required to bid for a minimum of 12 shares, an investment of Rs 13,428 at the upper end of the price band.

figures.label: Jio IPO final overall subscription
figures.evidence: Jio Platforms' IPO attracted strong investor interest on the final day of bidding, with the issue subscribed 22.19 times overall against 19.75 crore shares on offer.

figures.label: Jio IPO final QIB subscription
figures.evidence: The qualified institutional buyers (QIB) portion saw robust demand, with subscriptions reaching 70.55 times against 4.90 crore shares on offer.

figures.label: Jio IPO final NII subscription
figures.evidence: Meanwhile, the non-institutional investors (NII) category was subscribed 14 times against 3.64 crore shares reserved for the segment.

figures.label: Jio IPO final retail subscription
figures.evidence: The retail individual investor (RII) category was subscribed 2.72 times against 8.50 crore shares reserved for the segment.

figures.label: Jio IPO final employee quota subscription
figures.evidence: Employees' quota was subscribed 2.93 times and Reliance shareholders category got 7.6 times the shares on offer.
